changelog:
**Major update: Comprehensive, structured guide to prompt engineering, merging design-time specifications and runtime reasoning modes.**

- Rewrote and expanded skill documentation, combining design standards (from prompt-craft) and reasoning modes (from prompting-modes).
- Introduced clear system prompt templates for role, iron rules, failure handling, context management, and test cases.
- Added detailed explanations of five major reasoning modes (CoT, SC, ToT, ReAct, P&E) with when/how to use each.
- Provided best-practice guidance for multi-agent topologies, failure recovery, and collaborative routing.
- Added two new reference files: modes-reference.md and implementation-guide.md; removed obsolete skill-card.md.
- All documentation is concise, actionable, and structured for both design- and execution-phase use.
